description: Add, change, or remove a user-requested analytics or marketing script in the selected site's root layout. Name the provider, identifiers, and requested behavior. After publication, the script may send visitor data to that provider. Starts an asynchronous internal-agent operation; poll get_agent_session. For corrections, call this same tool with its sessionId and unchanged target. Requires a provisioned site. Source edits may execute in its preview. The Replo agent uses its normal tools and connected integrations to implement and verify the requested changes. Use publish_site separately to make changes public.

instructions.description: Requested changes for this operation only. Include necessary references, not conversation history, credentials, or unrelated personal data.

sessionId.description: Omit to start this operation. To continue, supply the returned sessionId with the same operation and target; mismatches and legacy sessions are rejected.
